subject: PE
title: Physical Education 7
description: Seventh-grade physical education emphasizing team-building, invasion and net games, striking and fielding, dance, track and field, and outdoor pursuits, all tied to personal fitness. Students take the FITNESSGRAM (California's grade 7 Physical Fitness Test), set SMART goals, learn the FITT principle and heart-rate training zones, and finish the year with a self-designed fitness plan. Most sessions include a dynamic warm-up, skill practice, game play and cool-down; they can be done in a yard, park or community center with siblings, parents or a homeschool group.
framework: California Physical Education Model Content Standards (Grade 7); 2009 CA Physical Education Framework

standards.PE-7.1.1: Combine manipulative, locomotor and nonlocomotor skills into movement patterns in individual, dual and team activities.
standards.PE-7.1.2: Demonstrate mature techniques for throwing, catching, striking and kicking in modified game situations.
standards.PE-7.1.3: Demonstrate offensive and defensive skills (passing, dribbling, guarding, marking) in invasion and net games.
standards.PE-7.1.4: Perform rhythmic and dance sequences with a partner or group, including line and cultural dances.
standards.PE-7.1.5: Demonstrate basic skills of an individual or outdoor activity (orienteering, jump rope, track and field events).
standards.PE-7.2.1: Explain and apply offensive and defensive strategies in invasion, net/wall and striking/fielding games.
standards.PE-7.2.2: Analyze movement performance using biomechanical principles such as force, follow-through and base of support.
standards.PE-7.2.3: Explain how to create space and use teamwork to achieve a goal in game play.
standards.PE-7.3.1: Participate in moderate-to-vigorous physical activity a minimum of four days each week.
standards.PE-7.3.2: Assess muscular strength, muscular endurance, aerobic capacity, flexibility and body composition using a fitness assessment.
standards.PE-7.3.3: Meet age- and gender-specific fitness standards (Healthy Fitness Zone) for aerobic capacity, muscular strength and endurance, flexibility and body composition.
standards.PE-7.3.4: Develop and implement a one-week personal physical fitness plan using the FITT principle.
standards.PE-7.4.1: Explain the FITT principle (frequency, intensity, time, type) and the principles of overload, specificity and progression.
standards.PE-7.4.2: Identify and calculate target heart-rate zones and monitor intensity during activity.
standards.PE-7.4.3: Explain the components of a proper warm-up and cool-down and how they prevent injury.
standards.PE-7.5.1: Demonstrate responsible personal and social behavior, including safety, fair play and sportsmanship.
standards.PE-7.5.2: Accept responsibility for individual improvement and set SMART goals.
standards.PE-7.5.3: Work cooperatively with group members to solve problems and accomplish goals; demonstrate leadership.

units.title: Fitness Assessment and Goal Setting
units.big_idea: Knowing your baseline fitness lets you set realistic goals.

units.title: Cooperative Challenges and Team Building
units.big_idea: Groups succeed through communication, trust and shared leadership.

units.title: Invasion Games: Soccer and Ultimate
units.big_idea: Creating and denying space is the key to invasion games.

units.title: Net and Wall Games: Volleyball, Badminton, Pickleball
units.big_idea: Placement, footwork and returning to base win points in net games.

units.title: Principles of Training
units.big_idea: The FITT principle and heart-rate zones guide safe, effective training.

units.title: Basketball and Striking/Fielding Games
units.big_idea: Offense and defense strategies transfer across team sports.

units.title: Dance and Rhythms
units.big_idea: Dance is cardiovascular exercise and cultural expression.

units.title: Individual Pursuits: Jump Rope and Track & Field
units.big_idea: Individual events build personal bests through technique and practice.

units.title: Outdoor Pursuits and Personal Fitness Plan
units.big_idea: Lifelong fitness comes from enjoyable activity and a personal plan.

objectives: Complete the PACER or mile run baseline

days.title: Dynamic warm-up
days.work: Learn a 10-move dynamic warm-up (high knees, butt kicks, carioca, leg swings) and a static cool-down stretch routine.

days.title: PACER practice
days.work: Practice the 20-meter PACER pacing for 5 minutes with the audio cadence.

days.title: PACER test
days.work: Complete the 20-meter PACER (or timed mile) and record laps or time.

days.title: Active recovery
days.work: Take a 30-minute brisk walk or bike ride and log it in a fitness journal.

days.title: Reflect
days.work: Compare your PACER score to the Healthy Fitness Zone chart and write one observation.

objectives: Complete curl-up, push-up, trunk lift and sit-and-reach tests

days.title: Curl-up form
days.work: Practice cadence curl-ups with correct form, then test to maximum.

days.title: Push-up form
days.work: Practice 90-degree push-ups at cadence, then test to maximum.

days.title: Trunk lift & sit-and-reach
days.work: Test trunk lift and back-saver sit-and-reach and record results.

days.title: Body composition (optional)
days.work: Record height and weight privately with a parent and learn what the BMI/Healthy Fitness Zone measures.

days.title: Record & reflect
days.work: Enter all scores in a fitness portfolio and highlight strengths and areas to improve.

days.title: SMART goals
days.work: Write two SMART goals based on baseline scores (e.g., 'add 8 PACER laps by January').

days.title: Circuit 1
days.work: Complete an 8-station circuit (jumping jacks, squats, planks, mountain climbers) 40 seconds on, 20 off, 2 rounds.

days.title: Goal action plan
days.work: Plan weekly activities to reach each goal and post them on a calendar.

days.title: Circuit 2
days.work: Repeat the circuit and try to increase reps at each station.

days.title: Check
days.work: Journal on how the circuit felt and rate perceived exertion.

days.title: Hula-hoop pass
days.work: Pass a hoop around a hand-held circle without letting go and improve time over 5 tries.

days.title: Blind walk
days.work: Guide a blindfolded partner through an obstacle course using only verbal cues.

days.title: Group juggle
days.work: Keep several balls moving in a set pattern with family members, adding balls each round.

days.title: Human knot
days.work: Untangle a human knot or complete 'toxic waste' transfer with rope.

days.title: Reflect
days.work: Discuss which communication strategies worked and write a reflection.

days.title: Lead a warm-up
days.work: Plan and lead the family through a 5-minute warm-up.

days.title: Capture the flag
days.work: Play capture the flag with a group and practice calling fair play.

days.title: Conflict scenarios
days.work: Role-play 4 game conflicts (disputed call, ball hog) and solve them respectfully.

days.title: Create a game
days.work: Design a new tag game with rules that include everyone, then teach and play it.

days.title: Check
days.work: Self-assess sportsmanship with a checklist.

objectives: Pass with the inside of the foot

days.title: Passing technique
days.work: Practice inside-foot passes against a wall, 50 with each foot.

days.title: Receiving
days.work: Practice receiving with sole, inside foot and thigh and controlling in one touch.

days.title: Passing on the move
days.work: Pass with a partner while jogging through cones.

days.title: Rondo
days.work: Play a 3-v-1 keep-away rondo focusing on quick passes.

days.title: Skill check
days.work: Complete a passing accuracy test (10 passes into a cone goal from 10 meters).

days.title: Dribbling
days.work: Dribble through a cone slalom using both feet and three different touches.

days.title: Shooting
days.work: Practice instep shots at targets from 12 meters, focusing on plant foot and follow-through.

days.title: Creating space
days.work: Play 2-v-1 games learning to spread wide and move into open space.

days.title: Small-sided game
days.work: Play 3-v-3 soccer applying width and support.

days.title: Check
days.work: Self-assess dribbling and shooting with a skill rubric.

objectives: Catch with pancake and rim catches

days.title: Backhand
days.work: Practice backhand throws to a partner at 5, 10 and 15 meters.

days.title: Forehand
days.work: Learn the forehand (flick) grip and throw 30 times.

days.title: Catching
days.work: Practice pancake and rim catches at different heights.

days.title: Pivot and pass
days.work: Practice pivoting to avoid a marker and completing a pass.

days.title: Check
days.work: Complete a throwing-accuracy test into a hoop target.

weeks.topic: Ultimate frisbee: game play and Spirit of the Game

days.title: Cutting
days.work: Practice cutting to get open and receiving passes in a 2-v-1 drill.

days.title: Marking
days.work: Practice marking a thrower with a 10-second stall count.

days.title: Rules & Spirit
days.work: Learn ultimate rules and the Spirit of the Game, then play a 3-v-3 game.

days.title: Game day
days.work: Play a full game of ultimate and self-officiate calls.

days.title: Check
days.work: Rate your own and teammates' spirit and strategy on a scorecard.

days.title: Compare games
days.work: Make a chart comparing strategies in soccer, ultimate and basketball.

days.title: Tournament 1
days.work: Play a mini soccer tournament with a homeschool group or family.

days.title: Tournament 2
days.work: Play a mini ultimate tournament.

days.title: Skills test
days.work: Complete a unit skills test (passing, dribbling, throwing, catching).

days.title: Reflect
days.work: Write about which strategies transferred between games.

weeks.assessment: Unit skills test and strategy reflection.

days.title: Ready position & bump
days.work: Practice ready position and forearm pass to self 20 times, then against a wall.

days.title: Set
days.work: Practice overhead sets to self and to a wall target.

days.title: Partner passing
days.work: Bump and set with a partner, counting consecutive contacts.

days.title: Movement to ball
days.work: Practice shuffling to the ball before passing.

days.title: Check
days.work: Complete a consecutive-pass skill test (target 15).

objectives: Use three contacts in game play

days.title: Underhand serve
days.work: Practice underhand serves over a net, 20 attempts.

days.title: Overhand serve
days.work: Try overhand serves and compare success rates.

days.title: Rules
days.work: Learn rotation and scoring and play 2-v-2 with three contacts.

days.title: Game day
days.work: Play doubles volleyball games.

days.title: Check
days.work: Complete a serving accuracy test into court zones.

days.title: Grips and serve
days.work: Learn forehand and backhand grips and practice short and long serves.

days.title: Clear
days.work: Practice overhead clears to the back of the court.

days.title: Drop shot
days.work: Practice drop shots and discuss when to use them.

days.title: Game play
days.work: Play singles games applying clears and drops to move the opponent.

days.title: Check
days.work: Complete a rally-count test with a partner.

weeks.assessment: Rally test and game strategy observation.

days.title: Groundstrokes
days.work: Practice forehand and backhand groundstrokes against a wall.

days.title: Dinks and volleys
days.work: Practice dinking at the kitchen line and volleys with a partner.

days.title: Rules
days.work: Learn the serve, two-bounce rule and kitchen rule, then play doubles.

days.title: Game day
days.work: Play a pickleball round robin at a local court.

days.title: Check
days.work: Analyze your follow-through using a phone video.

days.title: Strategy chart
days.work: Compare strategies in volleyball, badminton and pickleball.

days.title: Favorite game
days.work: Play your favorite net game for the full session.

days.title: Skills test
days.work: Complete the net games skills test.

days.title: Teach a skill
days.work: Teach one net game skill to a sibling or parent.

days.title: Reflect
days.work: Write about biomechanics (follow-through, base of support) in your best skill.

days.title: FITT
days.work: Learn the FITT principle and analyze three sample workout plans.

days.title: Cardio session
days.work: Complete a 25-minute jog/walk interval and record FITT details.

days.title: Overload & progression
days.work: Plan a 4-week progression for push-ups and try week 1.

days.title: Specificity
days.work: Match exercises to fitness components and to sports.

days.title: Check
days.work: Take a FITT quiz and log the week's MVPA minutes.

objectives: Measure resting and working heart rate

days.title: Taking a pulse
days.work: Measure resting heart rate at the wrist and neck for 3 mornings.

days.title: Target zone
days.work: Calculate maximum heart rate (220 − age) and a 60–85% target zone.

days.title: Zone workout
days.work: Do a 20-minute workout, checking pulse every 5 minutes to stay in zone.

days.title: Recovery heart rate
days.work: Measure heart rate recovery 1 and 3 minutes after exercise and graph it.

days.title: Check
days.work: Write an explanation of how heart rate shows fitness gains.

days.title: Muscle groups
days.work: Match 10 body-weight exercises to the muscle groups they train.

days.title: Form
days.work: Practice squats, lunges, push-ups, planks and glute bridges with a form checklist.

days.title: Design
days.work: Design a 6-station strength circuit for all major muscle groups.

days.title: Perform
days.work: Perform your circuit for 2 sets and record reps.

days.title: Check
days.work: Re-test push-ups and curl-ups for mid-year progress.

weeks.topic: Flexibility, injury prevention and mid-year plan

days.title: Stretching
days.work: Learn 8 static stretches and when to use static vs. dynamic stretching.

days.title: Yoga
days.work: Complete a 30-minute beginner yoga session.

days.title: Injury prevention
days.work: Learn the RICE method and common sports injuries.

days.title: Plan
days.work: Write a one-week FITT plan covering all fitness components.

days.title: Check
days.work: Follow day 1 of the plan and review progress toward SMART goals.

objectives: Make chest, bounce and overhead passes

days.title: Dribbling
days.work: Practice stationary and moving dribbles with each hand and crossovers through cones.

days.title: Passing
days.work: Practice chest, bounce and overhead passes with a partner, 20 each.

days.title: Triple threat
days.work: Practice triple-threat position and jab steps.

days.title: Keep-away
days.work: Play 2-v-1 keep-away with dribble and pass.

days.title: Check
days.work: Complete a timed dribble course.

days.title: Shooting form
days.work: Practice BEEF shooting form from close range, 50 shots.

days.title: Layups
days.work: Practice right- and left-handed layups.

days.title: Give-and-go
days.work: Practice give-and-go and defensive slides.

days.title: Game
days.work: Play 2-v-2 or 3-v-3 half-court games.

days.title: Check
days.work: Complete a shooting test from 5 spots.

days.title: Throwing
days.work: Practice overhand throws with step and follow-through at 15 and 25 meters.

days.title: Fielding
days.work: Field grounders and fly balls hit or thrown by a partner.

days.title: Batting tee
days.work: Practice level swings off a tee, 40 swings.

days.title: Soft toss
days.work: Hit soft-tossed balls and aim at field zones.

days.title: Check
days.work: Complete a throwing accuracy and batting contact test.

days.title: Base running
days.work: Practice running through first and rounding bases.

days.title: Fielding decisions
days.work: Practice where to throw in force-out situations.

days.title: Rules
days.work: Learn basic rules and play a modified game of 3-pitch softball.

days.title: Game day
days.work: Play a full game with a homeschool group or family.

days.title: Check
days.work: Write about one strategic decision you made in the game.

days.title: Coach a drill
days.work: Plan and lead a drill for basketball or softball.

days.title: Game day 1
days.work: Play a basketball game.

days.title: Game day 2
days.work: Play a softball/kickball game.

days.title: Skills test
days.work: Complete the unit skills test.

days.title: Reflect
days.work: Write about leadership and sportsmanship during the unit.

weeks.assessment: Unit skills test and leadership reflection.

days.title: Counting music
days.work: Clap and step to 8-counts in three songs of different tempos.

days.title: Basic steps
days.work: Learn grapevine, step-touch, pivot turn and box step.

days.title: Line dance 1
days.work: Learn and perform the 'Cupid Shuffle' or 'Electric Slide'.

days.title: Line dance 2
days.work: Learn and perform a second line dance and check heart rate afterward.

days.title: Check
days.work: Perform a line dance for family without the video.

objectives: Perform folk dances from different cultures

days.title: Mexican folk dance
days.work: Learn basic steps of a Mexican folk dance like 'La Raspa'.

days.title: Israeli/European folk dance
days.work: Learn 'Hora' or 'Virginia Reel' formations.

days.title: West African dance
days.work: Follow a West African dance video and learn about its connection to drumming.

days.title: Compare
days.work: Compare formations and purposes of the three dances.

days.title: Check
days.work: Perform one folk dance with family members.

days.title: Choose music
days.work: Choose a song and map its sections.

days.title: Choreograph
days.work: Choreograph a 32-count routine using levels and pathways.

days.title: Rehearse
days.work: Rehearse and refine transitions with partners.

days.title: Perform
days.work: Perform the routine for family.

days.title: Reflect
days.work: Reflect on dance as cardiovascular exercise using heart-rate data.

days.title: Basics
days.work: Practice basic bounce, alternate foot and side swing for 10 minutes.

days.title: Tricks
days.work: Learn criss-cross and boxer step.

days.title: Endurance
days.work: Complete 5 one-minute jump rounds with 30-second rests.

days.title: Routine
days.work: Create a 1-minute jump rope routine with 5 skills.

days.title: Check
days.work: Perform the routine and record continuous-jump time.

days.title: Sprint drills
days.work: Practice A-skips, B-skips and high knees for sprint form.

days.title: Starts
days.work: Practice standing and three-point starts over 20 meters.

days.title: Timed 50m
days.work: Run and time three 50-meter sprints.

days.title: Relay handoffs
days.work: Practice baton handoffs with a partner.

days.title: Check
days.work: Analyze sprint form on video.

days.title: Pacing
days.work: Run 4 × 400m at an even pace, recording splits.

days.title: Fartlek
days.work: Complete a 20-minute fartlek run.

days.title: Long run
days.work: Run or run/walk 2 miles at a conversational pace.

days.title: Timed mile
days.work: Run a timed mile and compare to baseline.

days.title: Check
days.work: Graph mile progress and reflect on your SMART goal.

objectives: Perform standing long jump and softball/shot throw

days.title: Standing long jump
days.work: Practice arm swing and takeoff and measure 3 jumps.

days.title: Running long jump
days.work: Practice approach and takeoff into sand or grass.

days.title: Throw
days.work: Practice softball throw for distance or medicine-ball put.

days.title: Angles
days.work: Experiment with release angles and record which goes farthest.

days.title: Check
days.work: Measure best marks in each event.

days.title: Prep
days.work: Plan events and warm-up for the meet.

days.title: Meet day 1
days.work: Compete in sprints and long jump.

days.title: Meet day 2
days.work: Compete in distance run and throw.

days.title: Recovery
days.work: Do a light recovery walk and stretch.

days.title: Reflect
days.work: Record personal records and reflect on improvement.

days.title: Compass skills
days.work: Learn to take a bearing with a compass in the yard.

days.title: Orienteering course
days.work: Complete a homemade orienteering course with 6 checkpoints.

days.title: Trail prep
days.work: Learn hiking safety, Leave No Trace and pack a day bag.

days.title: Hike
days.work: Complete a 3–5 mile hike at a local or state park.

days.title: Reflect
days.work: Journal on the hike's distance, elevation and how it felt.

days.title: PACER
days.work: Retake the PACER or mile.

days.title: Strength tests
days.work: Retake curl-ups and push-ups.

days.title: Flexibility tests
days.work: Retake trunk lift and sit-and-reach.

days.title: Active play
days.work: Play a favorite game from the year.

days.title: Compare
days.work: Graph baseline vs. post-test scores and evaluate SMART goals.

days.title: Plan
days.work: Design a 4-week summer plan using FITT for all fitness components.

days.title: Trial day 1
days.work: Complete day 1 of the plan.

days.title: Trial day 2
days.work: Complete day 2 of the plan and adjust intensity.

days.title: Barriers
days.work: Identify barriers to staying active and plan solutions.

days.title: Check
days.work: Present the plan to a parent.

days.title: Plan field day
days.work: Plan field day stations for family or a homeschool group.

days.title: Field day
days.work: Run and participate in the field day.

days.title: Favorite activity
days.work: Spend the session on your favorite activity from the year.

days.title: Portfolio
days.work: Finalize the fitness portfolio with all scores and reflections.

days.title: Reflect
days.work: Write a year-end reflection on fitness and sportsmanship growth.
